entities.summary: Chrysta Bell Zucht, known professionally as Chrystabell, is an American singer and songwriter, known for her collaborations with filmmaker David Lynch. Before working as a solo artist, she was the lead singer of the swing band 8½ Souvenirs, with whom she recorded two albums.
